## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`; see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Tests added or updated (`npm test`, and `npm run test:network` for socket-level changes)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under "Unreleased"
- [ ] Applies upstream too? Say so, and it can be offered to obegron/rootlessRelay
